name: Jelly QoL
description: Quality-of-life features for Jellyfin 12.1: blinking filter warnings, configurable service shortcuts, search ordering, native context menus, pagination, announcements and media visibility. English and Polish.
overview: Media Hider, QoL, Services and Announcements settings.

versions.changelog: Renamed the bulk notification action to Mark as read (Oznacz jako przeczytane). The read and clear-history buttons in the bell panel now share one horizontal row, including narrow mobile layouts.

Added per-account Appearance settings to hide all or selected header library shortcuts and show Favorites as a heart beside the notification bell. The profile menu uses the supplied user-attributes icon at its original 24px size. Notification panels close on outside clicks. Added Clear notification history for the current account only, preserving preferences and future notifications. Removed the premature Seerr-account-link notice.
Removed the About section from the profile settings panel. Notifications and History remain available.

The notification bell now opens a compact, non-blocking panel in the top-right corner. Removed automatic notification popups on entry, navigation and new events. The bell only displays the unread count and notifications; profile settings remain separate. Removed the automatic-popup switch while preserving account preferences and history.

Fixed the notification bell pushing the avatar below the other header buttons. The bell now lives in the header actions row instead of the avatar container, with a bounded 44px size and no outer margins. Preserves the notification-save fixes from 1.6.1.

Fixed a false notification-save error: successful HTTP 204 responses are no longer parsed as JSON. Administrator settings and account notification preferences now display success correctly. Empty optional account mappings are accepted. Existing settings and webhook secrets are preserved.

Added optional completed Seerr request webhooks and Jellyfin library notifications, with exact media matching and native library/Media Hider access checks. Profile settings popup, account preferences, grouped episodes, bell, history, unread state, once-per-account popups and one-hour reminders. Both sources enabled by default; administrator activation required. Includes webhook setup, secret rotation, account mappings, diagnostics and Test preview.

Added a native Jelly QoL settings shortcut in the administrator sidebar. Announcement Test previews unsaved fields without saving, counting views or changing dismissal state. Redesigned responsive announcement cards with clearer typography, icons, bullet details and a prominent action button.

Blinking filter icon without toolbar text. Added configurable header shortcuts, native right-click menus, Movies/Series/Seerr search ordering with empty-section handling, toast icons, top/bottom pagination, optional scheduled announcements. Four settings tabs: Media Hider, QoL, Services, Announcements. Names and URLs are saved in server configuration; no personal defaults are bundled.

Renamed to Jelly QoL. Added live active-filter warnings for Jellyfin 12.1, optional animation, separate Media Hider and QoL tabs, and a simple text-only thumbnail. Existing visibility settings, groups and schedules are preserved.

Optional user groups, independent one-time reveal date and time for each group, administrator-only fallback without groups, simple catalog thumbnail, and in-memory File Transformation integration. Existing title settings are preserved.
